_provenance.subject: eastern Uttar Pradesh (Purvanchal) — regional problem-space
_provenance.source: Prism public API — news.themes, news.trends, research.disease (disease_profile), research.evidence
_provenance.note: A PLACE, not a single claim. The intelligence here lives in the news corpus and the extracted disease-claim layer, NOT in title-matched academic research — and the report shows exactly where each tool could and could not resolve the region.

news_distinctiveness.what: news categories over-represented for 'eastern Uttar Pradesh' vs the all-India baseline (lift), with article counts

hazard_composition_pct.what: the top weather sub-themes as a share of labelled east-UP weather items — what the climate signal is actually made of
hazard_composition_pct.reading: a fifth of all weather coverage (rainfall 14.1% + monsoon 6.3%) is water; forecasting and lightning alerts fill most of the rest; heat is minor

news_distinctiveness.reading: the distinctive signature of east-UP news is extreme weather — monsoon, flooding, thunderstorm/lightning — anchored on Gorakhpur and spilling into Bihar and Jharkhand

narrative_flow.what: this brief is read as one causal chain, not a flat set of angles — each section sets up the next
narrative_flow.chain: climate signal (monsoon/rainfall, 58x) -> flooding & water-logging (disaster, 17x) -> encephalitis risk factors (monsoon, water-logging, malnutrition) -> child mortality (2019 spike 692 claims); poverty & weak health system ('inaction of the state machinery') amplify the final step
narrative_flow.join: the SAME water factors (monsoon, water-logging, heavy rainfall) appear in BOTH the climate signal and the encephalitis risk-factor list — the corpus supplies the link between the dominant hazard and the signature health crisis

hazard_events.note: dated, high-priority alerts; every quote verified against its source; publisher names withheld per deliverable policy; IMD = India Meteorological Department (public body)

calendar.verbatim: dense fog ... zero visibility or below 50 metres across 13 districts of the Terai belt and eastern UP
IMD orange alert: 47°C heatwave with thunderstorms, lightning; an earlier report records a death toll from the heatwave in eastern Uttar Pradesh, Bihar
many major rivers across the state flow above the danger mark; Ganga above danger mark, Allahabad, Varanasi flooded

flood_mechanism.two_sources: monsoon rain from above + water released from Nepal into the rivers (the Ghaghra and Rapti rise in Nepal)
flood_mechanism.verbatim: late monsoon rain, along with water released from Nepal into our rivers, have been causing flooding of fields
flood_mechanism.impact: flooding of fields (crop loss) and water-logging lingering into the encephalitis season

hazard_events.development_countermove: April 2026: a 'Centre of Excellence' in Gorakhpur, built with a major IT-services firm to teach emerging technology to youth of eastern UP
hazard_events.extractor_discipline: news_factors discarded two further flood factors 'because no source named' — it keeps only factors tied to a verified report

verticals.note: the full problem-space; publisher, company and individual names withheld per policy. Crime and migration are read at the event level because the corpus under-categorises them.

landscape_top20_priority.what: the region's highest-priority stories by vertical, of the top 20 it is central to

health_wider.encephalitis_deaths_verbatim: 399 deaths this year (brain fever), reported by the Gorakhpur government medical college
other: drug-resistant TB work at a Gorakhpur tertiary hospital
new 32-bed ICU to relieve severe patients from Eastern UP, Bihar and Nepal
health_wider.reading: health is wider than encephalitis; one Gorakhpur hospital is the referral point for three jurisdictions — the health geography mirrors the flood geography

crime.category_signal: weak — the literal term 'crime in Uttar Pradesh' returns ~17 articles; crime news is tagged by specifics, not by the word 'crime'
crime.verbatim: a man arrested in Chandauli carrying 'five pistols ... five magazines of 32 bore', running them from Munger (Bihar) toward Bhadohi; a sitting Lok Sabha MP reporting a 'threat to life ... criminals in Eastern Uttar Pradesh are planning to harm him'
crime.reading: a trafficking-and-muscle story, not a property-crime beat; under-registers in categorical coverage because it lives in one-off seizures and threats

news_level.irrigation_upside: Saryu Canal project expansion to cover '14.04 lakh hectare' of irrigation, 'great relief to the farmers of Eastern Uttar Pradesh'
news_level.flood_downside: the same rivers flood the same fields — 'flooding of fields'; a monsoon flood 'faded the happiness of Rakshabandhan' as people reached relatives 'by boat'

research_scope.tool: Prism research-scope (question -> scope of extracted findings + scope-id -> model re-analysis per focus)
research_scope.why: the academic corpus does not index 'eastern UP', so the scope was run on the agro-ecological system it belongs to: the eastern Indo-Gangetic rice-wheat plain

soil.reading: conventional puddling/tillage keeps soil organic carbon low or drains it; conservation agriculture rebuilds it near the surface
metrics: conventional-till rice-wheat gained only 0.9 t C/ha
zero-till + residue gained 3.0-4.7 t C/ha (3-5x conventional)
intensified cropping depleted total organic carbon 17.56% at 0-30 cm
zero-till lifted SOC +20%/+40% in 0-15/15-30 cm
non-puddled rice + residue: SOC +79%, N +62%
tillage had no effect below 0.15 m
gypsum + pressmud raised total organic carbon 32-64% with ~25% higher yield
rice-wheat yield rose with soil carbon, fell with pH / exchangeable-sodium-% / bulk density
the Gangetic aquifer is spatially heterogeneous (recharge, permeability, storage, chemistry)
UP groundwater neutral-to-alkaline, CaMgHCO3-type, rock-dominated
40% of samples exceed the 50 mg/l nitrate limit
shifting wheat sowing dates could unlock +69% untapped wheat potential
system rice-equivalent yield 15.72-16.39 t/ha (conservation) vs 10.30 (baseline)
nutrient-expert fertiliser cut wheat global-warming potential 12-20%; >80% of farmers raised yield and income
resource-poor farm households most exposed to simulated drought, cushioned by off-farm income

agriculture_economy.reading: at the news level agriculture is water (canal vs flood); the science-scope flow adds the soil/salinity/yield depth the news cannot — same corpus, different engine

migration_economy.fact: labour out-migration is Purvanchal's defining economic fact; the research corpus cannot measure it (see research_layer_limits)
migration_economy.policy_response_verbatim: land-ownership certificates distributed to tribal and resettled families; a Gorakhpur 'Centre of Excellence' with a major IT-services firm to teach 'emerging technology to the youth of Eastern Uttar Pradesh'; power-department staff 'mobilised against privatisation'
migration_economy.reading: the state is trying to manufacture reasons to stay; whether the belt can hold its own people is the question under every vertical

religion_tourism.volume: religion + culture + tourism ~250 articles; religion alone at ~8x lift
religion_tourism.reading: the one vertical whose dominant tone is positive; it is what pulls the autumn mood back above the line

totals.reading: somewhat more negative than ordinary news coverage

sentiment_seasonality.reading: mood tracks the hazard calendar — net negative in May-Jul (heat, monsoon flood) and the January cold snap; net positive in Oct-Nov (festival / harvest)

research_scope_deepdives.tool: Prism research-scope (question -> scope of extracted findings + scope-id -> model re-analysis per focus); build_s = scope + analyze seconds
research_scope_deepdives.note: run on the agro-ecological / epidemiological systems the region belongs to, because the academic corpus does not index 'eastern UP'

health_etiology.focus: etiologic agents of acute encephalitis syndrome
health_etiology.finding: scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi), not Japanese encephalitis, is the leading identified cause of AES in eastern UP
metrics: 50% of 2,529 hospitalised AES cases antibody-positive, 37% DNA-positive for O. tsutsugamushi
Gorakhpur seroprevalence 70.8% epidemic vs 50.6% lean season
JE virus in 10.3% of 407 Gorakhpur AES patients; dengue 7.1%
scrub typhus is treatable with doxycycline, unlike JE

flood_drivers.finding: floods are driven by rainfall concentration and ground saturation, not rising mean rainfall (which is falling)
metrics: annual/monsoon rainfall declined across Bihar 1901-2002 (-2.17 / -2.13 mm/yr)
monsoon months carry 84% of Bihar's rainfall
late-Sep 2019 central/east Bihar 176% above average, soil moisture 19% above
~2 m monsoon groundwater head swing tops up rivers
7,019 km2 of Bihar submerged in one monsoon

groundwater.focus: drivers of groundwater depletion and contamination
groundwater.finding: groundwater depletion is irrigation-driven with basin-scale downstream costs; nitrate contamination confirmed locally
metrics: irrigation raised modelled evapotranspiration 12% across the Ganges basin
net irrigation ~101 mm/yr (67 km3), 70% in the dry season
83% of 300 eastern-UP farmers increased irrigation
irrigation-driven depletion cut Bay-of-Bengal freshwater flow up to 1,200 m3/s/yr
reduced irrigation mapped to wheat-yield loss -4% to -36%
Varanasi borewells 80% over the 50 mg/l nitrate limit

migration.finding: honestly thin — the research corpus does not characterise out-migration from eastern UP (no flow/destination data; Bihar-proxy, observational)
metrics: circular labour migration tracks scarce local opportunity (single observational finding)
Gulf migration + remittances improved livelihoods (60 Bihar migrants); pandemic debt burden
no data on migration flows, destinations within India, or Purvanchal specifically

news_volume.note: a balanced, mixed-sentiment regional stream — unlike a national triumph or scandal story

encephalitis.spike_note: the 2019 surge (692 claims) tracks the Muzaffarpur / north-India encephalitis outbreak coverage

risk_factors.factor: lack of medical facilities in government hospitals

encephalitis.reading: the corpus frames the encephalitis crisis as a socio-environmental AND a governance failure — monsoon, water-logging and malnutrition alongside 'inaction of the state machinery', 'poor governance' and 'lack of medical facilities'. High-tier share is only 3% (mostly news-derived claims).

research_layer_limits.what: region-specific academic lanes that did NOT form — the honest boundary of title-matched research for a sub-national place

lanes.claim: acute encephalitis syndrome causes high child mortality in eastern Uttar Pradesh
lanes.result: no_data — ok:false; 'acute encephalitis syndrome' has 197 titles but the region+child-mortality intersection is 0

lanes.claim: recurrent river flooding damages agriculture in eastern Uttar Pradesh
lanes.note: the 5 subject papers are about Sikkim, Sundarban, J&K — not east UP

lanes.claim: lack of local employment drives labour out-migration from eastern Uttar Pradesh
lanes.note: thin; 'labour out-migration' n=5 titles, 'employment in eastern uttar pradesh' n=0

research_layer_limits.reading: the academic title index does not resolve sub-national Indian regions; Prism declined to fabricate a lane and routed the question to the news and disease-claim layers instead
